evidence: The full body checks whether the input record is nonnull, reads its 16-bit selector at +0x152, and if that value is supported, resolves a nested entry from +0x154 and writes the selector at nested +0x24. It then performs context lookup work and unconditionally clears the record's +0x19c byte, sets +0x152 to 0xffff, and zeros +0x14c. Callers invoke this as a record cleanup/refresh step, including before forwarding a sentinel selector and while iterating entries. decompiled/main/main_0054.c:31760-31815; callers decompiled/main/main_0054.c:31742-31755 and decompiled/main/main_0058.c:28358-28451.

The body reads the global object at 0x700228c598, queries three nested values through f_7000aa0468, reads a 32-bit value from the last returned object at +8, and on its completion path passes the gathered state and input payload through helpers before calling the accepted handler handle_storyline_moment_failed_selection_event (f_7000df3eec). Multiple callers route payloads through this helper; its body supports preparation for that failure event, while the individual global fields remain unidentified. decompiled/main/main_0105.c:26740-26795; caller decompiled/main/main_0105.c:26293-26300.

The body reserves a 0x2a30-byte temporary area, derives validation flags from the input selector and status arguments, invokes a helper, then calls iterate_and_validate_context_entries (f_70006b6c10) with the original context values and temporary result area. Callers consume the returned value as a count/validity result while processing context entries. decompiled/main/main_0052.c:35150-35206; decompiled/main/main_0050.c:6057-6062 and 39393-39401.

The body checks the input record's byte at +0x428 and, when needed, requires attribute-context selector 0 to return status 1. It then obtains a context entry and requires its 16-bit flags to intersect 0x6; failure returns -2. On success it preserves values 0..15, maps values above 15 to 16, and maps negative signed inputs to -2. Callers pass float-converted attribute values and store the result. decompiled/main/main_0112.c:37036-37078; callers decompiled/main/main_0111.c:29060-29064 and decompiled/main/main_0112.c:6485-6488.
